pages.text: Altered from $(5)Channeling$(), $(4)Empyrean Conduit$() causes lightning to come down upon both the user and the enemy, as long as there is a view of the sky. Maximum level is $(4)I$() and it conflicts with $(5)Riptide$(), $(5)Channeling$() and $(4)Eruption$().

pages.title: Notes
pages.text: On top of working regardless of weather, Empyrean Conduit's lightning on the user can be used offensively too, since it still has its usual range of damage infliction; a crude and painful version of a sweeping attack, if you will...
